summary: Privately owned tower on Ratlum Mountain near Canton, CT. Build date and designer unconfirmed; a 2008 forum post says it stood then, and a 2021 blog still sees it.

facts.design: A 2008 forum reply says the property owner built it from Western US fire tower plans; not verified

access.note: On private property. The 2008 forum post says visitors are not welcome; the 2021 blog says the owner has asked people not to go to the tower.

visit.trail_note: Private land. Do not climb or trespass; ask the landowner first.

events.note: Forum post in August 2008 says the tower still stands
Blog post in August 2021 says the tower can be seen from Route 44 in New Hartford

corrections.why: The CTMQ blog uses this fuller name, which places the tower on Ratlum Mountain. The record's name comes from a generic map label.

notes_for_editor: No build date, designer or owner name is confirmed. The only build claim is an unverified forum reply (2008). The OpenStreetMap record (way 428652238) names a private owner; that name is left out of the story on purpose. The Connecticut former-lookout register (8 sites) does not list this tower. A land-records check in Canton (summit parcel) would give the owner of record and may date the tower. The 2008 forum post says the tower stood then; the 2021 blog implies it still does, but neither is a current inspection. Access is private: the story does not encourage visits.
